Running command: python3 << 'EOF'
import struct

data = b'\x5a\x4c\x49\x42' + b'\x00\x00\x00\x00' + b'\x00\x00\x00\x01' + b'\x00'
print("Section data:", data.hex())

dest = bytearray(13)
len_remaining = 13
for cnt in range(4):
    if len_remaining < 4:
        print(f"cnt={cnt}: len={len_remaining} < 4, early return")
        break
    src_word = struct.unpack('>I', data[cnt*4:cnt*4+4])[0]
    dest_word = struct.unpack('<I', struct.pack('>I', src_word))[0]
    dest[cnt*4:cnt*4+4] = struct.pack('<I', dest_word)
    len_remaining -= 4
    print(f"cnt={cnt}: src_word=0x{src_word:08x}, dest_word=0x{dest_word:08x}, len={len_remaining}")

print("Converted data:", dest.hex())
print("Bytes 0-3:", dest[0:4], "= 'ZLIB'?", dest[0:4] == b'ZLIB')

gsize = struct.unpack('<Q', dest[4:12])[0]
print(f"gsize (little-endian): 0x{gsize:016x}")
gsize_be = struct.unpack('>Q', struct.pack('<Q', gsize))[0]
print(f"gsize after be64toh: 0x{gsize_be:016x} = {gsize_be}")

d_size = 13
hsize = 12
size_in = d_size - hsize
print(f"size_in = {size_in}")
print(f"size_out / 1032 > size_in: {gsize_be // 1032 > size_in}")
print(f"gsize + 23 < d_size: {gsize_be + 23 < d_size}")
EOF
